description_en: Submits a trace watermark extraction job
description_zh: 调用此接口提交溯源水印提取作业
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-trace-extract-job --input '{"Bucket":"example","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"example.mp4"}' --user-data 123 --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --params '{"m3u8Type":"v1"}' --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTraceExtractJob

parameters.help_en: The OSS address of the input file for trace watermark extraction
parameters.help_zh: 待提取溯源水印文件的输入OSS地址
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: A publicly accessible URL of the video file. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter
parameters.help_zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
Parameters for the extraction job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

m3u8Type: The algorithm type. Default: v1.

v1: Extracts an M3U8 file with an absolute path.

v2: Extracts an M3U8 file with a relative path
parameters.help_zh:
提取任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

m3u8Type：算法类型，默认值为v1。

v1：提取绝对路径的m3u8。
v2：提取相对路径的m3u8
parameters.name: params
